{{Quote|Once we know what it is we've got, too. We're sitting on the cloning equivalent of the Sacred Scroll of Gurrisalia and we can't read the language not well enough, anyway.|Mereel|<ref name="Republic Commando: True Colors">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>}}
